settled_verdict_station_dhcp.status: SETTLED LIVE — write-only wire-plane hint; do not treat as a REST schema key
settled_verdict_station_dhcp.summary: wirelessStationDhcp appears 0 times in the catalog schema and is NEVER echoed by the REST GET — it is a write-only wire-plane (media-info frame) hint with INVERTED semantics: write false = DHCP addressing (STA_DHCP=1), write true = static (STA_DHCP=0). One-shot: a PUT false flips the lan block addressingType static→dynamic + OnvifAutoAdapt false→true once, then the flag disappears from subsequent GETs. The deterministic REST lever is the explicit lan {addressingType, dhcp} write on /NetSDK/Network/interface/4, not this flag.
